مُتْلِدٌ [act. part. n. of 4:] A possessor of property such as is termed تِلَاد: and hence, ―
-b2- A first owner or proprietor; as the weaver of a piece of cloth, and the man who delivers his she-camel [and is owner of her young one]. (Mgh.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
